question.prompt: Which of the following is equal to \(2000 \cdot 2000^{2000}?\)

solutions.explanation:
The power \(2000^{2000}\) is a product of \(2000\) factors, each equal to \(2000\). Multiplying by one more \(2000\) gives \(2001\) such factors. Equivalently, the same-base multiplication rule gives
\[
2000\cdot2000^{2000}
=2000^1\cdot2000^{2000}
=2000^{2001}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{2000^{2001}}\), choice \(\text{A}\).
solutions.title: Combine powers with the same base
